Not applicable to stationary combustion, power-sector fuel activity, non-road equipment, freight tonne-km, WTT, or WTW. The source describes these as developing values subject to review. Its methodology text cites AR6 GWP100, while the table labels a nitrogen column NO2 and shows 27.9*B + 273*C; GreenLedger retains the published rounded factor value without silently correcting that source-method inconsistency. Source-owner clarification remains advisable.
